content.rendered:
Hello SCS families!

Welcome to the 2021-2022 school year! In preparation for a fantastic year ahead, we are providing a Back to School newsletter with important information you won’t want to miss. Included is updates on what in-person learning will look like this year, as well as important upcoming events. Check it out using the link below!

Click to view the Back to School Newsletter
